blockers.description: Composition quantifier step: at depth k+1, given z with nf_eval_nf M (k+1) 4 (z,y1,x1,t1) sub4, find z' with nf_eval_nf M (k+1) 4 (z',y2,x2,t2) sub4. Requires simultaneous 2-var NF transfer using the (k+2)-level 1-var NF hypothesis. The IH gives 4-var NF agreement from matching 1-var NFs + orders, so the problem reduces to finding z' with same 1-var NF as z and same order region relative to y2,x2,t2. This is the Doets Lemma 1.4 transfer for linear orders.
blockers.goal_state: ∃ z', nf_eval_nf M (k+1) 4 (Fin.cons z' (Fin.cons y2 (Fin.cons x2 (fun _ => t2)))) sub4
